summary: A genuine source-only SIPP pilot retained the annual person-month panel for 32 selected sample units and checked source income identities.

evidence.annual_contributor_scope: December members aged 15 or older, followed across their months and residences; unknown child receipt stays masked.

limitations: This is a 32-sample-unit diagnostic pilot with 33 December residence groups, not a population estimate or a fitted housing model.

The 383 tested income identities and 17 skipped cases concern monthly groups, not people or person-month records. The separately counted 17 unknown-child person-month rows do not establish a one-to-one link to skipped groups.
Complete December adult-contributor coverage does not establish unrestricted annual household-income completeness. Source-valid masks and unknown child receipt remain explicit.
No monetary microdata or income totals are published here. Income identity agreement is a source consistency diagnostic, not transfer accuracy.
Cross-survey income/price alignment, housing fitting and transfer, calibration, national/CD validation and pruning remain separate; no release acceptance follows.
